title: Ремонтвижн — дизайн по фото с материалами и ценами
description: Примерьте ремонт до покупок: дизайн вашей комнаты по фото, реальные товары и смета. Две генерации бесплатно, без подписки.

inputs.value: sofa, armchair, coffee_table, rug, floor, paint, wallpaper, skirting, light, outlets, textile
the sofa, armchairs, coffee table, TV/media console and their realistic proportions; the architecture, camera, walls, windows, doors and ceiling height. Do not block doors or windows.

floor finish, wall finish, lighting, textiles, decor and styling. Replace or restyle the sofa, armchairs, coffee table and storage using the listed furniture. You may rearrange freestanding furniture to improve composition and flow while keeping it functional.
A sofa or armchairs, coffee table, TV/media console, shelving, rug and layered lighting are appropriate.
No bed, no kitchen cabinets, countertop, sink or faucet, no toilet, shower or bathroom fixtures. Do not replace the floor with large-format porcelain tile unless a floor product is provided.

Style the sofa with cushions and a throw; add a rug, coffee-table books, ceramics, a tray, candles, art, plants, a floor lamp and a sculptural chair. Layer textiles and warm light; make it feel collected, not staged. If there is a TV, mount it flush with hidden cables or use a frame TV; cover the radiator with a slim grille. Add a warm cove or wall wash. Replace old blinds with floor-length curtains or a clean Roman blind; hide the cornice. Add a gallery wall, open shelving with books and ceramics, and a modern laptop, headphones or speaker styled on the console or coffee table — visible and on a surface, never on the floor. Hide all cables, chargers and straps.
